revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate for achievement_medal_travel_tier_002, later converted into a transparent 768x768 app asset
Primary request: Create one premium collectible travel achievement medal for tier 2, GREEN rank, based on the Chinese title concept "小富即安" (modestly rich and immediately satisfied). The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Input image role: the attached rank-medal screenshot is a reference for progressive border complexity only; do not copy its shield shape, numbers, dark UI, text, or exact design.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. Tier 2 has an ordinary circular medal plus simple decoration: a glossy emerald-green enamel rim, polished silver-green metal bevel, two small side tabs or clasp-like ornaments, and a tiny top gem; clearly more decorated than tier 1 but still restrained. Inside the circle is one compact funny center object: a cream travel suitcase wrapped in a plush U-shaped neck pillow with a small cozy folded blanket, relaxed and satisfied. The suitcase is dominant; pillow and blanket form one comfort accessory cluster.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, refined and readable at small iOS size, playful but premium, crisp transparent-asset silhouette, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: base circular size consistent with a six-medal set; tier 2 outer decoration slightly larger than tier 1; full medal visible, no cropping; centered symmetrical front view.
Lighting/mood: cozy light luxury, bright studio rim light, clean enamel glints.
Color palette: emerald green rim, pearl/silver metal, warm cream suitcase, soft cream pillow, small royal blue blanket, small white glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: glossy enamel, polished green-silver metal, plush pillow, folded blanket, subtle beveled rim, lacquered toy surfaces, clean edges. No paper texture.
Text: none.
Constraints: one medal only; no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no map, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no camera, no airplane, no seat, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no shield badge, no black background, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
title: 小富即安
concept: 绿色普通圆形加简单扣件，中心为舒适旅行箱
integration_note: TripPet 1.0.8 travel medal redesign: six-level white, green, blue, purple, orange, gold rank progression; source PNG copied byte-identically to app-facing @3x PNG.
